Career Spotlight Finder v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a skill for uncovering hidden strengths, industry buzzwords, and personal branding narratives from past projects, articles, or code.
- Guides users through initializing a local career profile directory, collecting and validating diverse project sources (local paths, URLs, docx files), and analyzing them for career value.
- Supports priority tagging of projects (highlight/supporting) to tailor narrative emphasis.
- Handles directories intelligently: distinguishes between single projects and document collections.
- Checks for existing or out-of-date analyses, ensuring results reflect up-to-date material.
- Stores all analyses and outputs locally for privacy and easy reuse in resumes and self-introductions.
